title: IXDE attempt in the closed condensate food chain: with slower fuel (Du 1) and no prey-predator repulsion, prey and predator condensates both divide from noise (prey generation 2-6, predators 2) and coexist to t=12000; prey divide only because predators eat them (twin: frozen emulsion); a fuel cut kills both
summary: world.py is c36's closed food chain (fuel -> prey condensate -> predator condensate -> waste -> fuel, no feed) with chi 0, k0 0.002 and fuel diffusion Du 1 (was 2), the regime found in 20261026T1131-c42-foodchain-cycles-sighting, 20261026T1200-c42-mixed-diet-predators and 20261026T1240-c42-slowfuel-standing-ecology. From smoothed noise (128^2, seeds 0-2, t=12000; 256^2 seed 3, t=10000), prey droplets and predator droplets form; predators engulf prey into rings, the rings break into arcs that round up into new predator droplets, and prey droplets split as dumbbells and C-shapes. Labkit with a 500 t lineage window (--lineage-k 5): prey persistent splits 9/17/5 (max generation 2/6/2, merge/split 0.11-0.27), predators 30/34/34 (generation 2/2/2, merge/split 0.25-0.32); at 256^2 prey 30 (generation 3), predators 112 (generation 2); predators alive at the end on every run (22/28/27 and 106 components). Matched predator-free twin (pred_on 0, same seeds, grid, duration): a frozen emulsion of 71-77 prey droplets, 0/0/1 prey divisions after t=2000 by splits2.py against 14/16/4 with predators. E fork (efork/): removing all fuel and its regrowth at t=6000 dissolves every prey droplet within 100 t and every predator droplet within ~700 t on seeds 0 and 1, while the fed twin keeps 7-14 prey and 30-33 predators at t=8000.

claims.statement: From noise (pack/seed0-2 at 128^2, pack256 seed 3; command: python -m labkit.run world.py --seeds <s> --size 128 128 --frames 120 --lineage-k 5 --no-movie), two kinds of condensate individuals form, prey (fuel-made) and predators (made only from prey material); both divide repeatedly into separate daughters that persist >= 500 t (prey generation 2-6, predators generation 2 on every seed), they coexist to the end of every run, predation turns the frozen prey emulsion of the matched twin into a dividing, turning-over prey population held at 6-10 droplets, and cutting the fuel kills individuals of both kinds while the fed twin keeps them.
claims.track: seed 1 (pack/seed1): the prey lineage reaching generation 6 (pack/seed1/lineage.png; prey divisions in strips/s1_prey.png at t=1700-11300, several next to predators) and the predators that eat these prey and divide (species predator, 34 persistent splits, generation 2); the same seed's E fork (efork/efork.png right panel) takes these populations at t=6000 and both die.

controls_run.X: pack_nopred/ (pred_on 0, seeds 0-2, same grid, duration and lineage window): 71-77 static prey droplets, prey persistent splits 7/2/4 all in the formation phase, 0/0/1 divisions after t=2000 (strips/nopred_*.json) vs 14/16/4 with predators (strips/s*_ch0.json); predator side: predators made only from prey material, and the mixed-diet forks in 20261026T1200-c42-mixed-diet-predators
controls_run.E: efork/ (tcut 6000: fuel set to 0 and waste->fuel regrowth r=0, seeds 0 and 1) vs the fed twin fed_s0/fed_s1 run in parallel: prey 12->0 droplets by t=6100, predators 32-36 -> 0 by t=6700

limits: Lineage window 500 t (K=5 frames): with the default 2000 t window predator persistent splits are 0 because predator droplets rarely live 2000 t between events; prey keep 5-14 at K=10. Predator division is fragmentation of a ring formed around an eaten prey droplet into arcs of unequal size that round up; the predator body plan alternates between droplet, ring and arc. Prey also appear by nucleation from fuel (k0). E holds by construction (prey are built only from fuel and decay, predators only from prey). The strips are random divisions, not selected by generation. No dt/2 or grid-spacing variant; 256^2 is one seed.
